text:
devon: Seeing apiserver p95 jump to ~1.8s in eu-west1, controller-manager backlog climbing and a bunch of pods stuck Pending waiting for GPU attach. Spike started ~09:12 UTC.
sre-bot: [ALERT] apiserver.high_latency eu-west1 p95=1800ms
maria: checked etcd metrics — leader follower-lag increased, raft retransmits up. One etcd member shows WAL fsync tail latency bumps.
raj: can we check kube-proxy conntrack / NAT usage? last time we saw something similar it was SNAT pool exhaustion + proxy half-opens.
sam: NAT gateway (eu-west1-nat-1) SNAT ports climbed to ~88% around the timeframe, and envoy logs show a lot of TCP resets.
devon: pasting a tiny apiserver log snippet we captured:
devon: ```
E0319 09:12:34.123 apiserver.go:234] read tcp 10.0.0.1:6443: connection reset by peer
E0319 09:12:35.456 watch.go:98] watch reconnected; backlog=1024
```
kate: controller-manager lease processing time jumped — leader election renewals getting delayed. If apiserver client conns are flapping due to conntrack/SNAT pressure, controllers will stall.
maria: on the etcd node with fsync spikes, iostat shows nvme_io_time elevated. It hosts heavy attach-controller pods for GPU lifecycle. Rebooting would help but that triggers GPU detach/attach churn.
raj: immediate mitigations: 1) restart kube-proxy on a few nodes to flush conntrack entries, 2) scale apiserver replicas up temporarily, 3) route controlplane traffic to a different NAT or enable SNAT autoscale.
ops-oncall: I'm going to restart kube-proxy on 3 nodes in eu-west1-b (rolling) now, monitoring metrics.
sre-bot: deploy action: kube-proxy restart (eu-west1-b) initiated by ops-oncall
ops-oncall: kube-proxy restarts done on the selected nodes. apiserver p95 dropped to ~300ms within 90s, controller backlog reduced from ~1600 -> ~120. GPU attach latency still elevated (~30s vs baseline 6s) but no longer saturating controllers.
devon: great, can someone open the incident ticket and capture RCA steps? I'll follow up with cost impact for the SNAT autoscaling and potential dedicated controlplane subnet.
maria: opening INC-2026-1441, adding metrics and timelines. I'll also add a grafana alert for etcd follower_lag > 200ms and kube-proxy conntrack_used > 75%.
sam: I'll schedule moving the attach-controller off the NVMe-hot node and propose a maintenance window to repro and confirm fsync source (possible kernel/usermode issue).
kate: assigning follow-ups: @maria storage team for nvme, @sam attach-controller refactor, @raj network/SNAT autoscale evaluation.
devon: thanks all — followups in ticket. :thumbsup:
